rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a physical cushion or pad, including a seat pad and the specialist gold-leaf pad.

example.english: I put a cushion on the hard chair, and it is much more comfortable to sit.
example.traditional: 我喺張硬櫈上面放咗個墊子，坐得舒服好多。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 zoeng1 ngaang6 dang3 soeng6 min6 fong3 zo2 go3 zin3 zi2 zo6 dak1 syu1 fuk6 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use this for extra points, time, or another intangible reserve that can absorb a loss.

example.english: We have enough cushion in this competition, so even losing one game will not affect our qualification.
example.traditional: 今次比賽我哋有足夠餘裕，就算輸一局都唔影響出線。
